_definition: 'relevant' means: a clause a compliance analyst reviewing this obligation would want in front of them. NOT 'a clause that must be textually amended'. Retrieval's job is to surface every candidate; deciding whether a clause actually needs changing is impact classification, scored separately from Day 44. Merging the two into one label would make a low score impossible to attribute.
_contamination_warning: These queries were written by the same author as the corpus and share its vocabulary. Measured recall@10 0.944 on 2026-09-10 partly reflects that. Day 37 replaces them with obligations extracted from real Federal Register documents.

note: Direct hit on the seeded contradiction. Both retention clauses genuinely apply and disagree; a system that returns only one is hiding a conflict.
query: The provider shall retain automatically generated logs for a period of not less than twelve months, and shall make them available to the competent authority upon a reasoned request.

note: Clean single answer. If this one is not rank 1 something is badly wrong.
query: Covered entities shall notify affected individuals of a breach of unsecured protected health information without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of the breach.

note: Near-miss trap. The vendor-side clause is correct; the internal incident-response clauses are about Kestrel's own breaches and are wrong answers that look right.
query: A business associate shall report to the covered entity any security incident of which it becomes aware, including breaches of unsecured protected health information.

note: Spans two policies. Day 35 observation O2 predicts clustering will pull both from one document and miss the other.
query: Covered entities shall make reasonable efforts to limit access to protected health information to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose.

note: Spans two policies, and the retention figures must agree. Tests whether a cross-policy obligation is found on both sides.
query: Records supporting a claim submitted to a federal health care program shall be retained for a period of ten years from the date of service.

note: Domain-specific vocabulary that appears nowhere else in the corpus. Should be easy.
query: Software functions providing clinical recommendations shall enable the health care professional to independently review the basis for the recommendation rather than relying primarily upon it.

note: The hardest multi-policy case. Logging policy and model governance both impose it, in different words.
query: Where an automated system contributes to a coverage determination, the system shall record the inputs relied upon and the output produced.

note: Clean single answer with a distinctive number.
query: A person who has received an overpayment shall report and return the overpayment within 60 days after the date on which it was identified.

note: Special-category consent. P-010 §3.2 is the specific clause; §2.1 is the general rule and is a defensible second.
query: Records relating to substance use disorder treatment shall not be disclosed without the written consent of the patient, notwithstanding any other authorization.

note: UNANSWERABLE ON PURPOSE. No clause in this corpus covers environmental impact. The correct behaviour is to return nothing useful and say so. Day 35 measured 0.671 top similarity on a question like this — barely below a real hit at 0.691.
query: The agency shall prepare an environmental assessment addressing the impact of the proposed action prior to authorisation.
